description: For supplied compilers \(c,b\) and every finite translated-index list \(L\), the specified \(a(e,L)\) and \(q(e,L)\) are total computable jointly in \(e,\operatorname{code}(L)\). They satisfy \(a(e,L)\le|L|\), \(b(q(e,L))\notin L\), and \(\varphi_{q(e,L)}(x)\simeq\varphi_e(x)\) for every \(x\); every smaller position has its translated family value in \(L\). No semantic restriction on entries of \(L\) is assumed.
